The stock of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) reached all time high today, May, 10 and still has $197.64 target or 4.00 % above today’s $190.04 share price. This indicates more upside for the $934.07B company. This technical setup was reported by Barchart.com . If the $197.64 PT is reached, the company will be worth $37.36 billion more. Trading stocks at an all time highs is usually a winning strategy. An all time high points to a stock which has the most positive fundamentals ever. Even thought the pullback rate is high, if correct risk management is utilized, investors can trade very well such events.
